methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
demand response on a glass working company example, to

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy-efficiency and demand-side-management case study with NPV/MPC economic analysis; monitors process-level electricity consumption but does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach identifiable).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The case study is a glass-work company in Latvia

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: process-level consumption monitoring + a qualitative kWh/m2 mention could read as a simple-intensity EnPI, but no EnPI/EnB model is constructed; core is DSM + furnace NPV.
